run_get_flops: run the get_flops tool to compute FLOPs and parameter count for an MMDetection model config
run_get_flops_custom_shape: run get_flops with a custom input shape like 640x640 for a detection model config
build_detector_from_config: build an MMDetection detector model from a config file using build_detector
get_model_complexity_info: get the FLOPs and parameter count of a PyTorch model using get_model_complexity_info
parse_args_get_flops: parse command line arguments for the get_flops tool including config path and input shape
